name: Basilica of the Immaculate Conception
history: Monks of Engelberg Abbey in Switzerland founded the Benedictine monastery of New Engelberg at Conception in 1873; it became an abbey in 1881 with Frowin Conrad as first abbot. The abbey church's cornerstone was laid on 20 May 1883 and it was dedicated on 10 May 1891. A tornado struck it in 1893, and during rebuilding its Beuronese murals were added. It became a basilica in 1940-41.
arch: A long brick Romanesque Revival abbey church designed by the Franciscan Adrian Wewer, with twin square towers.
features: Its murals are in the Beuron style of German Benedictine art.
A two-decade, $9 million restoration was completed in 1999.

look.d: Twin towers rise over the farm country of northwest Missouri.
Inside, the murals were painted after the 1893 tornado.

fun: The abbey's seminary once trained a young Clarence Thomas, later a U.S. Supreme Court justice.
journal: Swiss monks in Missouri farmland. A tornado, then murals.

quiz.q: What art style are the murals?
